description: The pie chart represents the distribution of media sources cited in a study on narrative media framing in political discourse. There are 20 slices, each corresponding to a different media outlet. The largest slice represents Breitbart with 14%, followed by The Daily Caller and NPR, each with 8%. The chart includes a legend, and each slice is labeled with the name of the media outlet and its corresponding percentage. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not include percentage labels inside the slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
